text:
Carla: Heads up — new model intake from partner: horizon-11b v0.9 landed in s3. Weights + tokenizer delivered. Need provenance checks, registry entry, and a quick quant baseline. Prioritization?
Ben: copy the s3 path? I can start checksum/ingest once I have it.
Carla: s3://redwood-acquisitions/horizon-11b/v0.9/ 
Carla: files: horizon-11b-weights.pt, tokenizer.json, manifest.yaml, signature.sig
Priya: assigning this to model-onboard queue. Can we get SHA256 for each file and a signed manifest?
Carla: manifest has entries but partner didn't include sha256 fields, only signature.sig (ed25519).
Tom: if signature exists we still want hashes for our ledger and S3 object-metadata. I'll do sha256 and add to the registry.
Sasha: I can run a quick 8-bit quant smoke run and eval on our standard prompt-set once artefacts verified. ETA ~3h.
Ben: starting checksum now. CLI I used: ```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-acquisitions/horizon-11b/v0.9/horizon-11b-weights.pt ./ && sha256sum horizon-11b-weights.pt
```
Ben: got hash for weights: 9f4c2a3b8e7b... (truncated)
Ben: tokenizer.json hash: a1b2c3d4e5f6...
artifact-bot: Registered ledger entry: ingress/1725312345/horizon-11b-v0.9. Status: pending-provenance. KMS-key: projects/redwood/kms/acq-key.
Priya: good — Ben, can you attach the computed sha256 values to the manifest and upload manifest.sha256 to the same folder? Also record object-version IDs in the ledger.
Ben: will do. Also noticed tokenizer.vocab size mismatch vs model config (config.json says vocab_size: 50280, tokenizer.json shows 50279). :thinking_face:
Carla: hmm that could break tokenization at runtime. Partner might have trimmed an unused token; need to confirm. Priya, flag as blocker for serving until resolved?
Priya: flagging as blocker for Dedicated/Private rollout. For hosted + experimental we can test with a small mapping patch but only if Sasha confirms no generation regressions.
Sasha: I'll run tokenization diffs and a quick greedy generation test. If mismatch only affects a removed unused token, we can patch tokenizer by inserting placeholder token at the end and remap ids. I'll document any changes.
Tom: once hashes + manifest updated, I'll create a registry entry: ```bash
model-reg-cli register --name horizon-11b --version v0.9 --s3 s3://redwood-acquisitions/horizon-11b/v0.9/ --hashes manifest.sha256 --visibility private
```
Tom: tagging for prioritization: label=onboard-priority:low-medium-high? Recommend medium because partner requested quant results for cost estimate.
Carla: medium sounds right. Partner needs perf/quantization numbers to decide license.
Sasha: quick plan for experiments: 1) FP16 baseline run (latency + quality) 2) 8-bit GPTQ-style quant (static) 3) 4-bit QAT-ish attempt if 8-bit regresses. I'll post exact configs.
Ben: uploading manifest.sha256 and object version metadata now. Link: s3://redwood-acquisitions/horizon-11b/v0.9/manifest.sha256
artifact-bot: Ledger updated: ingress/1725312345/horizon-11b-v0.9 -> checksums attached.
Priya: Sasha, once you have the quality/latency table, include these columns: dataset, prompt-set-id, avg_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, perplexity (if applicable), human-score-delta, notes. We'll use that for prioritization call.
Sasha: ack. Will run evals on prompt-sets: llm-smoke-v2, instr-robustness, costbench-sample100.
Carla: if tokenizer mismatch requires partner fix, let's open a quick ticket with ingestion team to delay rollout and notify partner. If we can patch safely, proceed with testing and keep partner informed.
Tom: created internal ticket ML-ONBOARD-4827 for tokenizer-vocab mismatch and assigned to partner-comms.
Ben: all done on my side for hashes + upload. Leaving marker in comments with full SHA256 values.
Carla: thanks — we'll reconvene after Sasha posts quant/quality results. :eyes:
